# T8 — What the imputed prices can and cannot support (Task 4.4)

*Generated by `analysis/t8_safe_use.py` from the result tables; each verdict follows the stated rule.*

| Use | Evidence | Rule | Verdict |
|---|---|---|---|
| National monthly price movement (published index) | monthly corr with survey-only national index 0.81–0.87; slope 0.94–1.19 (T7n) | corr >= 0.8 and slope within 0.8-1.2 in every period | **supported (partly mechanical: observed cells enter both)** |
| Average price level of a market-month (point estimate) | MAPE 2.9–6.5%, median 1.7–4.2%, bias -1.5–1.6%, cells off >10%: 4–10% (T2) | MAPE <= 10% and |bias| <= 2% in every item x stratum | **supported for the average level, with stated uncertainty** |
| Cross-market price differences (draft-plan H2 criteria) | |bias| < 1% in 6 of 8 item x stratum cells; month-demeaned calibration slope in [0.9, 1.1] in 3 of 8 (range 0.57–1.11; below 1 = imputed differences between markets too large) (T2) | H2: |bias| < 1% and slope in [0.9, 1.1] in every item x stratum | **not supported (slope below 0.9, i.e. imputed cross-market differences overstated, in 4 of 8)** |
| Published high/low band as an uncertainty range | later survey value inside the band in 59% of test cells (T7) | coverage >= 80% | **not supported** |
| Market-specific month-to-month changes | corr 0.10–0.44 (own-release mean removed), -0.13–0.10 (within month); 95% CI includes 0 in 8 of 8 item x definition rows (T3) | corr >= 0.5 with CI above 0 for >= 3 of 4 items (own-release mean) | **not supported** |
| Detecting local price spikes (>10%, persistent) | 29 of 138 survey spikes (21%) shown by a same-direction published move >= 5% (T3b) | share caught >= 50% | **not supported** |
| Imputed local changes as a regressor | calibration slope (beta_MZ) 0.15–0.63; 95% CIs rice [-0.47, 0.70], wheat_flour [-0.28, 1.06], oil [-0.73, 1.92], lentils [-0.37, 0.86]: include 1 for 2 of 4 items and 0 for 4 of 4, so the attenuation factor is not pinned down (T3) | beta_MZ within 0.8-1.2 for >= 3 of 4 items | **not shown to be valid (no reliable correction factor)** |
| Trust score as a guide to cell reliability | univariate -1.13 pp error per trust point (p = 0.019); 86% of clean cells have trust 10 (T4) | p < 0.05 and >= 20% of clean cells below trust 10 | **limited** |
| Imputed history for never-surveyed markets (mostly 2007–2019) | never-observed cells: median year 2015, share >= 2020 0.23–0.27; hold-out covers 2023-09..2026-08 only (A3) | median price year inside the hold-out window (2023-09..2026-08) | **not evaluable with this design** |
| Early-warning alerts (FAO IPA; all alerts, D4 local-event filter not applied) | IPA alert recall 0.45–0.49 vs 0.41–0.47 for a simulated value with no local information and 0.69–0.71 for one that removes noise but keeps local signal, base rates matched (T6); ALPS not informative here: 54% of clean cells are 'Alert or Crisis' on survey values | recall exceeds the no-local-information benchmark by >= 0.10 for both IPA variants | **not supported** |

**Caveat.** All rows are exploratory (pre-registration) and describe RTFP Bangladesh releases 2024-01-25 to 2026-10-05, evaluated on cells surveyed after imputation (price months 2023-09 to 2026-08). The rules are judgement thresholds chosen for readability, stated so readers can apply their own.
